items.author: fenrirreki.bsky.social
items.context: Still debating whether or not it'll be worth my $120+ to buy stage tour + a new guitar just for it. I kind of want the midnight guitar. Maybe i'll just wait for a sale on the midnight guitar and the game?
items.text: Waiting is a fair call when you're only half sure. Check the game's price history first, so you know what a real low looks like.

items.author: sadieadie.bsky.social
items.context: I think I played one on your recommendation a couple years ago but I didn't stick with it! I have a hard time sticking with PC games because I prefer to lay down when I play something and have the screen inches from my face 😂 I need a steam deck or something someday
items.text: A Steam Deck is that exact setup: lie back, screen close, no desk. Every Steam store page shows the game's Deck status too, so you can check before buying.

items.author: shuchancellor.bsky.social
items.context: Simp Simulator? Is it on sale on Steam? Gta would take up too much space on my pc and I need some for total war
items.text: A game's Steam store page lists its storage needs under system requirements, so you can check the space before you buy. Wishlisting it will also show you when it goes on sale.
